purpose: Individual reconciliation against each existing scope. Completed review is not product certification or proof that every gap is resolved.

applications.name: Actual Budget
applications.version: Source commit d1a536f35c5a114eda0582d5a1d744a9103cc90e; export, import, and automatic backup implementation inspected
E3: Export and automatic-backup source identify SQLite/metadata packaging, cache removal and discarded CRDT/clock context; import replaces sync/encryption identity. No balance-, rule- and schedule-preserving reconstruction of the declared budget and server context is recorded. These transformations define required recovery comparisons, not complete E3.
E5: Budgeting and optional bank sync involve consequential financial changes, but the collected export/backup code does not establish authorization, inspectable changes and correction for bank imports, rule execution, encryption transitions and sync conflicts. No financial transaction is inferred to be governable merely because the budget is local.
longevity: E3 is not established for Actual Budget's existing essential-record scope. The previous Longevity finding is replaced by Not assessed, not a verified failure or a positive placeholder.
transparency: The positive control observations above do not yet establish whole-scope E5. The methodology requires that minimum before a positive Transparency and Control finding; the previous positive finding is therefore withdrawn to Not assessed, not changed to Does not meet.
applications.remaining: balances, rules, schedules, bank-provider credentials, encryption behavior, and full sync-server recovery. E5 needs bank-import/rule/sync authorization, change visibility and correction boundaries in the configured budget.
applications.current_remaining: balances, rules, schedules, bank-provider credentials, encryption behavior, and full sync-server recovery. E5 needs bank-import/rule/sync authorization, change visibility and correction boundaries in the configured budget.
applications.next: Inspect a synthetic Actual export and expected balances/rules/schedules with SQLite/JSON tools; obtain pinned implementation or externally recorded bank-import, rule, undo and sync/encryption evidence. Use synthetic credentials only.
sovereignty: A positive Sovereignty finding requires established E1, E2 and E4 in the declared scope. The existing access/exit/custody record for Actual Budget does not establish all three minimums. The prior positive finding is withdrawn; recorded storage and portability strengths remain facts, not a verified failure.

applications.name: Gitea
applications.version: Source commit ad37b88631ade5af5db738a4ebe4ab89ed8d237d; dump storage coverage and repository export layout

applications.name: Paperless-ngx

E3: The exporter produces serialized model data plus files, not a raw database image; paths, conditional audit data and version behavior matter. Workflow execution, user permissions, trash/purge, metadata changes and inspectable correction remain insufficiently covered for the document-management profile.
